enemy_class_notes: Static map markers describe encounter loci, not a guaranteed spawned enemy tier.
Elite is a runtime stronger variant with additional affixes; no static E marker is emitted.
Operatives are co-op-only runtime enemies and therefore have no static map marker.
Mutation Agent is labeled A only for an exact authored actor; campaign horde anchors do not imply one.
Captain boss pits occur outside X-4; X-4 boss pits contain Destructors.

enemies.name: Caustic Stinger
descriptions: Circles its target and periodically darts in for a fast sting.
enemies.behavior: Navigation-clipped circle movement alternates with the recovered Darting Attack.

enemies.name: Tentacler
descriptions: Causes spiky thorns to emerge from underneath a hero..
Damage can be avoided by staying mobile.
enemies.behavior: It snapshots the hero’s position, warns there after one second, and damages only actors still inside the strict two-unit radius at 2.5 seconds.

enemies.name: Chrono Striker
descriptions: Tail strikes slow movement and attacks; it flees when nearby members of its species die.
enemies.behavior: Its melee applies the timed movement/attack slow, while the nearby-death counter drives its navigation-clipped flee phase.

enemies.name: Botanical Tunneler
descriptions: Tunnels close underground, then emerges with a poison area attack.
enemies.behavior: Its burrow animation and temporary intangibility accompany pursuit into the eight-unit radial Stagnant Nova.

enemies.name: Mending Tanglid
descriptions: Heals badly hurt allies; roots heroes, calls nearby friends to attack them, and keeps away from heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its strict-below-half support branch heals first, its repeated close-range retreat keeps separation, and Entangle applies the ranked root and redirects all living allies inside 20 units to that victim.

enemies.name: Grappling Pulsar
descriptions: Pull victims are slowed, then struck with rapid melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: The three-second Pulled modifier owns the forced-movement interval, then the phase uses the recovered nine-hit Fast Swipe while Puller cools.

enemies.name: Hypno Mantis
descriptions: Lobs a small sleeping cloud, then closes on sleeping heroes for a melee swipe.
enemies.behavior: Sleep Mushroom creates the three-tick radius-two cloud and close targets switch to Rez Melee.

enemies.name: Cannonator
descriptions: Fires a large slow moving projectile when at a distance from his target.
When engaging in close combat, will switch to close range melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: Authored phase order selects the slow projectile beyond eight units and melee at eight or nearer.

enemies.name: Warp Spawner
descriptions: Being shifted halfway into an alternate dimension makes them highly resistant to area effect attacks.
Launches time-space warping projectiles that will randomly teleport heroes who are hit by them.
enemies.behavior: Incoming area damage is reduced by 75 percent and a successful projectile hit performs the recovered random reachable-position teleport.

enemies.name: Ghostly Tracker
descriptions: Has high dodge and damages every hero touched during its charge.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating participates in avoidance and its clipped through-target charge resolves every path contact.

enemies.name: Shade Drifter
descriptions: Difficult to hit physically; charges through and silences heroes; drains nearby life.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating governs avoidance, the clipped through-target charge damages and silences every path contact, and each charge cycle pulses a local life-drain aura that heals the Drifter.

enemies.name: Invincitron
descriptions: Has an orbiting drone that will shoot lasers at heroes.
At half health, will become invulnerable for a limited time.
enemies.behavior: One untargetable owner-bound NomadDrone uses the exact baseline SentryDroneLaser against the captain's current target and is deleted with its owner; the captain retains its strict-below-half ranked shield.

enemies.name: Ragetusk
descriptions: Charges and knocks heroes up; grows and deals more damage when nearby allies die.
enemies.behavior: The existing charge and knock-up remain, while each nearby allied death now adds a bounded damage and body-size enrage stack.

enemies.name: Lightning Juggernaut
descriptions: Attacks with energy damage when up close.
explodes upon death.
Charges its target, explodes upon death
enemies.behavior: Footprint-aware charge pursuit hands off to Smash at close range without rejecting that secondary melee phase, and death starts cast_explode before the recovered 1.3-second, seven-unit elemental-energy detonation at the defeated world position.
